title: The Rights of Children upon Parents in Tarbiyah
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, mentioning Prophetic hadiths that urge the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It also highlights the importance of permissible play for children and not neglecting them. The text is unclear due to distorted letters and words.

review_defects.arabic: حقوق الأطفال على الآباء في التربية
review_defects.english: The Rights of Children upon Parents in Tarbiyah
review_defects.why: الآباء means fathers specifically, not parents; the translation broadens the reference to include mothers, altering the original meaning.
المباح is an Islamic legal term (mubah) that should be transliterated as 'mubah' rather than translated as 'permissible', especially since 'tarbiyah' is transliterated elsewhere in the same text.
